name: Héctor Rivera's Sweet Shrimp Coctel with Tomato-Avocado Salsa (Night 2)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · Plaza de Coco (Día de los Muertos Night 2)
whyItWorks: Poached shrimp and avocado cubes are great, but the Mexican coctel clamato/catsup sauce contains lime juice, raw onion, and jalapeño.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for plain poached shrimp and avocado slices on a clean plate without the citrus-spiked coctel sauce or raw onions.
watchOuts: Lime juice in coctel sauce (citrus guardrail)
